# @vllnt/convex-comments

> TypeScript Convex component for threaded comments and annotations on any resource: replies, author-only edit and resolve, soft-delete, paging.

Install `@vllnt/convex-comments` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0` (development and tests run on
1.51.0; the floor is not tested in CI). Mount it with `app.use(comments)` from
`@vllnt/convex-comments/convex.config` and call it through
`new Comments<TBody>(components.comments, { bodyValidator? })` from host
mutations and queries; every method takes the host `ctx` first. Methods: `post` (returns
`{ commentId }`), `edit`, `remove`, `resolve`, `get`, `list`, `count`, `prune`.
A comment is attached to an opaque `resourceRef`, written by an opaque
`authorRef`, and may reply to a `parentId` on the same resource. Status:
`resolve` moves between `open` and `resolved`; `remove` moves either to
`deleted` (soft-delete, body cleared, terminal). Only the original `authorRef`
may `edit`, `remove` or `resolve`. `list` pages the top level oldest first, or
one comment's direct replies with `{ parentId }`, excluding deleted comments
unless `includeDeleted`. `count` returns open plus resolved comments, replies
included. The component stores two tables: `comments` and `resourceCounts` (one
visible-comment counter per resource). Invalid input throws `ConvexError` with
`data.code` `INVALID_REF`, `PARENT_NOT_FOUND`, `PARENT_MISMATCH`,
`PARENT_DELETED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_AUTHOR`, `DELETED`, `INVALID_BATCH` or
`INVALID_BEFORE`. `INVALID_REF` is checked only by `post`. A built-in daily cron
prunes soft-deleted leaf comments older than 30 days; `prune` batch is 1–500
(default 200). The body is opaque; `bodyValidator` is a `(unknown) => TBody`
parser run on write and read, not a Convex `v.*` validator. The host owns auth
and the meaning of resources and authors; there is no React entry.

## When to use

- Use it when people discuss a resource (a post, doc, ticket or clip) in text
  threads with replies.
- Use it when you need inline annotations or review notes that their author
  resolves and reopens.
- Use it when only the original author may edit, resolve or remove a comment.
- Do not use it when people only like, vote or react without text: use
  `@vllnt/convex-reactions`.
- Do not use it when the thread is a conversation with an AI agent: use
  `@convex-dev/agent`.

## For coding agents

Docs for the installed version are in `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-comments/`:
`docs/API.md`, `llms.txt`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the TypeScript `src/`. Read them
before writing code against this package. The links below to `./` paths are
files inside the installed package.
